Company Release - 10/06/2026 CACI Schedules Fiscal Year 2027 First Quarter Conference Call


Reston, Va., October 6, 2026 – CACI International Inc ([NYSE: CACI](https://www.nyse.com/quote/XNYS:CACI) ) will release its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 after the market closes on Wednesday, October 21. The company will host a conference call the next morning, on Thursday, October 22 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time, during which CACI’s executive leaders will discuss quarterly results followed by a question-and-answer session.


You can listen to the call and view the accompanying exhibits on[CACI’s Investor Relations site](https://investor.caci.com/events/default.aspx) . A replay of the call will be posted and made available on[caci.com](https://investor.caci.com/investor-home/default.aspx) for one year following the event.


**About CACI**
CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit[caci.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caci.com%2F&esheet=53518889&newsitemid=20230809772368&lan=en-US&anchor=caci.com&index=3&md5=f3b24a566ff9f9ce98cc9d0b9874c85c) .
